description: This file defines data structures and a store class for managing the state of various communication channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and general message channels within an application. It includes Codable data models for channel statuses, snapshots, configurations, and UI metadata, as well as a ChannelsStore class that manages the state, configuration, and metadata for these channels.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton observable class responsible for managing channel statuses, configurations, UI hints, and application state related to various messaging platforms.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific UI metadata entry for a channel by ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly label for a channel ID, prioritizing metadata entries, then labels, then the ID itself.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Provides a detailed label for a channel ID, prioritizing metadata entries, then detail labels, then falls back to the general label.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Returns the system image/icon associated with a channel ID, defaulting to 'message' if none is specified.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs ordered according to UI metadata or the channel order array.
